note: Derived from the .jagvorbis payloads, which are the source; this listing is their table of contents and editing it changes nothing. Index 14 holds bare vorbis packets in Jagex's own framing, not Ogg: five big endian ints (sample rate, samples, loop start, loop end whose sign bit is the loop consistency flag, packet count) and then each packet, preceded by its length as bytes that add up with 0xff meaning 255 and more. Archive 0 is the vorbis setup header they all share, with its two block sizes in the first byte.
